These stories often involve royalty, intrigue, romance, and adventure.

In a mock Ruritanian comedy, these elements are exaggerated or played for laughs. The genre often pokes fun at the idealized, romanticized portrayal of these fictional countries and their societies. It can also satirize the conventions of the genre itself, such as the use of stock characters, predictable plotlines, and melodramatic situations.

Examples of mock Ruritanian comedies include the 1984 film "Top Secret!", which parodies both Ruritanian romance and Elvis Presley movies, and the 1993 film "Dave", which satirizes the political aspects of the genre.
